import pytest
from aho_corasick import AhoCorasick


class TestBasicMatching:
    def test_single_pattern(self):
        ac = AhoCorasick(["abc"])
        assert ac.search("xabcyabc") == [(1, "abc"), (5, "abc")]

    def test_multiple_non_overlapping(self):
        ac = AhoCorasick(["he", "she", "his", "hers"])
        results = ac.search("ahishers")
        found = {(pos, p) for pos, p in results}
        assert (1, "his") in found
        assert (3, "she") in found
        assert (4, "he") in found
        assert (5, "hers") in found

    def test_overlapping_patterns(self):
        ac = AhoCorasick(["ab", "bc", "abc"])
        results = ac.search("abc")
        found = {(pos, p) for pos, p in results}
        assert (0, "ab") in found
        assert (0, "abc") in found
        assert (1, "bc") in found

    def test_pattern_at_start(self):
        ac = AhoCorasick(["hello"])
        assert ac.search("hello world") == [(0, "hello")]

    def test_pattern_at_end(self):
        ac = AhoCorasick(["world"])
        assert ac.search("hello world") == [(6, "world")]


class TestEdgeCases:
    def test_empty_text(self):
        ac = AhoCorasick(["abc"])
        assert ac.search("") == []

    def test_empty_patterns(self):
        ac = AhoCorasick()
        ac.build()
        assert ac.search("hello") == []

    def test_single_char_patterns(self):
        ac = AhoCorasick(["a", "b", "c"])
        results = ac.search("abc")
        assert results == [(0, "a"), (1, "b"), (2, "c")]

    def test_duplicate_patterns(self):
        ac = AhoCorasick(["abc", "abc"])
        results = ac.search("xabcx")
        assert len([r for r in results if r[1] == "abc"]) == 2

    def test_pattern_longer_than_text(self):
        ac = AhoCorasick(["abcdef"])
        assert ac.search("abc") == []

    def test_pattern_equals_text(self):
        ac = AhoCorasick(["abc"])
        assert ac.search("abc") == [(0, "abc")]

    def test_repeated_char_patterns(self):
        ac = AhoCorasick(["aa", "aaa"])
        results = ac.search("aaaaa")
        found = [(pos, p) for pos, p in results]
        # "aa" at 0,1,2,3 and "aaa" at 0,1,2
        assert (0, "aaa") in found
        assert (0, "aa") in found
        assert (1, "aa") in found
        assert (1, "aaa") in found

    def test_unicode(self):
        ac = AhoCorasick(["αβ", "βγ"])
        results = ac.search("αβγ")
        found = {(pos, p) for pos, p in results}
        assert (0, "αβ") in found
        assert (1, "βγ") in found

    def test_special_regex_chars(self):
        ac = AhoCorasick(["a.b", "a*b", "a+b"])
        assert ac.search("xa.bx") == [(1, "a.b")]
        assert ac.search("xa*bx") == [(1, "a*b")]
        assert ac.search("xa+bx") == [(1, "a+b")]

    def test_whitespace_patterns(self):
        ac = AhoCorasick(["a b", "\t\n"])
        assert ac.search("xa bx") == [(1, "a b")]
        assert ac.search("x\t\ny") == [(1, "\t\n")]


class TestContainsAny:
    def test_found(self):
        ac = AhoCorasick(["abc", "def"])
        assert ac.contains_any("xyzabcdef") is True

    def test_not_found(self):
        ac = AhoCorasick(["abc", "def"])
        assert ac.contains_any("xyz") is False

    def test_empty(self):
        ac = AhoCorasick(["abc"])
        assert ac.contains_any("") is False

    def test_short_circuit(self):
        ac = AhoCorasick(["a"])
        assert ac.contains_any("ba") is True


class TestIncrementalBuild:
    def test_add_then_build(self):
        ac = AhoCorasick()
        ac.add("he")
        ac.add("she")
        ac.build()
        results = ac.search("shehe")
        found = {(pos, p) for pos, p in results}
        assert (0, "she") in found
        assert (2, "he") in found

    def test_rebuild_after_add(self):
        ac = AhoCorasick(["abc"])
        ac.search("abc")
        ac.add("xyz")
        # build() is called automatically by search if needed
        results = ac.search("abcxyz")
        found = {(pos, p) for pos, p in results}
        assert (0, "abc") in found
        assert (3, "xyz") in found


class TestStressPatterns:
    def test_many_short_patterns(self):
        patterns = [chr(i) * 2 for i in range(ord("a"), ord("z") + 1)]
        ac = AhoCorasick(patterns)
        text = "abcxyz"
        results = ac.search(text)
        found = {(pos, p) for pos, p in results}
        assert (0, "aa") not in found  # "aa" not in "abcxyz"
        # Each unique pair of adjacent chars should match its pattern
        for i in range(len(text) - 1):
            pair = text[i] + text[i + 1]
            if pair in patterns:
                assert (i, pair) in found

    def test_nested_patterns(self):
        ac = AhoCorasick(["a", "ab", "abc", "abcd"])
        results = ac.search("abcd")
        found = {(pos, p) for pos, p in results}
        assert (0, "a") in found
        assert (0, "ab") in found
        assert (0, "abc") in found
        assert (0, "abcd") in found


if __name__ == "__main__":
    pytest.main([__file__, "-v"])
